summary.text: Son of Hippasus (`hippasus-trojan`) and shepherd of the people, whom great Deïphobus smote in the liver beneath the midriff when the battle surged about the ships — brother of Charops and Socus in the house of Hippasus.

story.text: When the battle cried unquenchable arose about the ships, Deïphobus smote Hypsenor son of Hippasus, shepherd of the people, in the liver beneath the midriff with his mighty spear; and down he fell and darkness enfolded his eyes. His comrades bore him away from the battle, making great lamentation, and placed him in the chariot; but the horses that drew him were all in tears as they went, for they missed their goodly charioteer.
